as_told.title: Matthew Brown's tweet: White House has a proprietary AI that predicts future timelines

tellings.quote: As you now know, the @WhiteHouse  has long possessed a unique AI capable of accurately predicting a range of future events.

plain: In a post on X addressed to Elon Musk on 6 June 2025, a man introduced on the show as a Pentagon whistleblower, Matthew Brown, wrote that "the @WhiteHouse has long possessed a unique AI capable of accurately predicting a range of future events." Brown reads the claim out to Michels himself. On an earlier episode Michels had passed it on from memory, describing it as a kind of "crystal ball" or private AI that predicts "future timelines". If it were true, the government would be able to see what is coming.
